digest.component_or_area: Reconcile Bridge monitoring and CloudWatch integration
propositions: Reconcile Bridge runs on GitHub Actions with no CloudWatch observability; workflow failures are invisible to monitoring except via GitHub step summaries
GitHub Actions workflow must publish bridge_run_failures metric (1 on failure, 0 on success) to CloudWatch rebar/host namespace via OIDC-authenticated credentials
New narrowly-scoped IAM role must grant only cloudwatch:PutMetricData action constrained to rebar/host namespace, without widening existing drift-detection or Bedrock roles
CloudWatch alarm on bridge_run_failures must trigger on second failure within one hour (period 3600s, threshold 1) to distinguish transient blips from sustained outages like token expiry

Workflow metric publication steps must be gated on canonical repo and configured variables, be continue-on-error to prevent telemetry from failing reconcile, and treated as INSUFFICIENT_DATA when metric is absent to detect publisher breakage
